title: ReportKit publication intent (.reportkit/intent.json)
description: The user's decision, persisted in the consumer project by `reportkit target set` (agent reasoning loop spec §4.2). It never enters the ReportKit repository.

visual_reference.description: Project-relative path to the user's visual reference, if any.

composition_brief.description: Project-relative path to the target's composition brief.

alias.description: The natural-language alias the target was resolved from, if any.
